name: I Became an Evil Witch that Cursed the Male Lead
source:
I fell asleep playing a game where you romance a cute grim reaper and then... I woke up as the wicked witch in a dark fairy tale?!

In the original story, the evil witch was sealed beneath the castle for centuries. A young, unwanted prince kneels at her bedside every night, whispering prayers she never hears.

Eventually, the prince grows into a tyrant. And when the witch finally awakens, he drives his sword straight through the witch's heart... 

[From [url=https://fluuen.itch.io/i-became-an-evil-witch-that-cursed-the-male-lead]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我在玩一款与可爱的死神浪漫的游戏时睡着了，然后……我醒来时发现自己变成了黑暗童话中邪恶的女巫？！

在最初的故事中，邪恶的女巫被封印在城堡下面几个世纪。一位年轻的、不受欢迎的王子每天晚上都跪在她的床边，低声祈祷她从未听到过。

最终，王子成长为暴君。当女巫终于醒来时，他用剑直刺女巫的心脏…… 

[来自[url=https://fluuen.itch.io/i-became-an-evil-witch-that-cursed-the-male-lead]itch.io[/url]]
